title: HTTP designer health (1.2)
description: The body of GET /health on an HTTP-bound designer's origin -- design/designer-interface.md §7.1, "Arrays by reference". Required from a designer that accepts arrays by reference; the caller reads it once, before its first request by reference, and sends none if it does not match.

contract_version.description: the highest contract version the designer implements, e.g. "1.2"

shared_root.description: true when the designer is configured with a shared root, so it can honour an array sent by reference
